description: This is a PHP unit test class named LeaveRequestDaoTest, which tests various functionalities of the LeaveRequestDao class related to leave request operations in an HRM system. The tests include retrieving leave data, overlapping leave detection, total leave calculations, leave request creation, status changes, entitlement management, and various edge cases involving multi-day and partial day leaves. The class also includes helper methods for database assertions and fixture setup.
